messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":6,"verses":[{"chapter":6,"verse":1,"text":"And immediately my wife came near me and crying aloud and weeping she said: \"Job! Job! How long wilt thou sit upon the dung-hill outside of the city, pondering yet for a while and expecting to obtain your hoped-for salvation!\""},{"chapter":6,"verse":2,"text":"And I have been wandering from place to place, roaming about as a hired servant, behold they memory has already died away from earth."},{"chapter":6,"verse":3,"text":"And my sons and the daughters that I carried on my bosom and the labors and pains that I sustained have been for nothing"},{"chapter":6,"verse":4,"text":"And thou sittest in the malodorous state of soreness and worms, passing the nights in the cold air."},{"chapter":6,"verse":5,"text":"And I have undergone all trials and troubles and pains, day and night until I succeeded in bringing bread to thee."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 1,2,3,4,5 in this chapter.
